units.text: INT. SEAGULL - CONTINUOUS
TREPLIEFF gets up from his desk and goes out without a word.
There now! You have vexed him. I told you not to bother him.
units.name: MASHA

units.text: I am sorry for you, Masha.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: Much I need your pity!
units.name: MASHA

units.text: My heart aches for you. I see how things are, and understand.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: You see what doesn’t exist. Hopeless love is only found in novels. It is a trifle; all one has to do is to keep a tight rein on oneself, and keep one’s head clear. Love must be plucked out the moment it springs up in the heart. My husband has been promised a school in another district, and when we have once left this place I shall forget it all. I shall tear my passion out by the roots.
units.name: MASHA

units.text: The notes of a melancholy waltz are heard in the distance.
Constantine is playing. That means he is sad.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: MASHA silently waltzes a few turns to the music.
The great thing, mother, is not to have him continually in sight. If my Simon could only get his remove I should forget it all in a month or two. It is a trifle.
units.name: MASHA

units.text: DORN and MEDVIEDENKO come in through the door on the left, wheeling SORIN in an arm-chair.
I have six mouths to feed now, and flour is at seventy kopecks.
units.name: MEDVIEDENKO

units.text: A hard riddle to solve!
units.name: DORN

units.text: It is easy for you to make light of it. You are rich enough to scatter money to your chickens, if you wanted to.
units.name: MEDVIEDENKO

units.text: You think I am rich? My friend, after practising for thirty years, during which I could not call my soul my own for one minute of the night or day, I succeeded at last in scraping together one thousand roubles, all of which went, not long ago, in a trip which I took abroad. I haven’t a penny.
units.name: DORN

units.text: To her husband.
So you didn’t go home after all?
units.name: MASHA

units.text: Apologetically.
How can I go home when they won’t give me a horse?
units.name: MEDVIEDENKO

units.text: Under her breath, with bitter anger.
Would I might never see your face again!
units.name: MASHA

units.text: SORIN in his chair is wheeled to the left-hand side of the room.
PAULINA, MASHA, and DORN sit down beside him.
MEDVIEDENKO stands sadly aside.
What a lot of changes you have made here! You have turned this sitting-room into a library.
units.name: DORN

units.text: Constantine likes to work in this room, because from it he can step out into the garden to meditate whenever he feels like it.
units.name: MASHA

units.text: The watchman’s rattle is heard.
Where is my sister?
units.name: SORIN

units.text: She has gone to the station to meet Trigorin. She will soon be back.
units.name: DORN

units.text: I must be dangerously ill if you had to send for my sister.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: He falls silent for a moment.
A nice business this is! Here I am dangerously ill, and you won’t even give me any medicine.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: What shall I prescribe for you? Camomile tea? Soda? Quinine?
units.name: DORN

units.text: Don’t inflict any of your discussions on me again.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: He nods toward the sofa.
Is that bed for me?
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Yes, for you, sir.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: Thank you.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Sings.
“The moon swims in the sky to-night.”
units.name: DORN

units.text: I am going to give Constantine an idea for a story. It shall be called “The Man Who Wished--L’Homme qui a voulu.” When I was young, I wished to become an author; I failed. I wished to be an orator; I speak abominably,
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Exciting himself.

with my eternal “and all, and all,” dragging each sentence on and on until I sometimes break out into a sweat all over. I wished to marry, and I didn’t; I wished to live in the city, and here I am ending my days in the country, and all.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: You wished to become State Councillor, and--you are one!
units.name: DORN

units.text: Laughing.
I didn’t try for that, it came of its own accord.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Come, you must admit that it is petty to cavil at life at sixty-two years of age.
units.name: DORN
